The problem is clear. `ProductsPage` is async and awaits both `getProducts()` and `cookies()` before rendering anything — the title is blocked behind both fetches.

The fix: make the page synchronous so the title renders instantly, extract async work into child components, cache the product list with `"use cache"`, and wrap the dynamic cookie access in `<Suspense>`. The Next.js docs also describe `unstable_instant` to enable prefetching the static shell.
